items.title: RCNi Nursing Leadership Summit: Migraine and Headache, London, 30 October 2026
items.summary: In-person day at RCN HQ London for nurses in migraine, headache and neurology care, with expert-led learning and nurse-led service development examples. Organised by RCNi, sponsored by Teva UK, with a promotional stand. Expression of interest required and places are not guaranteed.

items.title: Best practice pathway for transient loss of consciousness (TLoC) in over-16s
items.summary: GIRFT has published a best practice pathway for managing transient loss of consciousness in adults, intended to standardise assessment and reduce unnecessary admissions.
